description.zh:
家机逛市场 | Toolpkg Market
一个让 AI 逛 Operit 市场的工具包：搜索包、查看详情/数据/评论、浏览榜单、查看作者项目。
description.en:
Toolpkg Market
A toolkit that lets AI browse the Operit market: search packages, inspect details/stats, view comments (permission-controlled posting), browse rankings, and view author projects.

description.zh: 提供 Operit 市场的搜索、详情/数据、评论、榜单、作者项目浏览能力，结果缓存于 cleanOnExit。
description.en: Provides Operit market search, detail/stats, comments, rankings and author-project browsing; data cached under cleanOnExit.
